brokenElectronicPdfSurrogates.sourceEvidence: HathiTrust bibliographic API record 001719567 identifies public-domain GPO bound-volume copies; the EOIR live volume and alphabetical links for these three PDFs return 404.
brokenElectronicPdfSurrogates.acceptanceGate: Ingest only from a lawful reproducible whole-volume/page-set route, retain HathiTrust holding and item provenance, segment by printed reporter page, and label the bytes library-scan-surrogate.

accessFindings: EOIR publishes two official image-only cumulative topical indexes for volumes 1-15. Their 74 pages are checksummed in supporting/manifest.json and can support citation/topic reconciliation after OCR, but do not contain the opinion text.
HathiTrust anonymous full view exposes stable page sequences and text-only view, but whole-book download requires an affiliated member-library login.

The volume 15 affected-decisions notice is verified at HathiTrust sequences 23-30 (printed pages XIX-XXVI), but those viewer pages have not been copied into this repository because the available access route is page-at-a-time and disclaims saving or redistribution.
HathiTrust page image requests returned rate limiting during the browser audit and are not suitable for an uncoordinated bulk crawl.

Google Books exposes a public PDF route for verified full-view IDs, but repeated anonymous capture triggered a human-verification interstitial; the route is not reproducible enough for authoritative ingestion and IDs have not yet been verified for every volume.
A bound-volume source must be segmented into cases by printed reporter page, with volume table-of-contents/index reconciliation and page-image checks before case records enter the main manifest.
acceptanceGate: Capture all seven complete volumes from a lawful, reproducible full-view route.
Record scan provider, holding institution, source item ID, byte count, and SHA-256 independently from the underlying government publication identity.
Extract the cumulative/numerical index and reconcile every case start page and interim-decision number.
Visually verify a stratified sample and every segmentation or citation conflict.
Label every resulting case as library-scan-surrogate rather than first-party-electronic.
